title: Customer registration with Aadhaar and PAN
statement: The system shall allow a prospective customer to submit registration details including Aadhaar and PAN identifiers.
preconditions: The prospective customer is not yet registered and has no in-flight KYC application of the same identity.
postconditions: A registration record is created and a KYC application (Aadhaar + PAN) is submitted for review.
assumptions: Aadhaar and PAN are the only KYC identifier types for v1 onboarding.

title: Aadhaar and PAN format validation
statement: The system shall validate Aadhaar and PAN inputs against defined format rules and reject malformed values.
preconditions: The prospective customer has entered Aadhaar and PAN values during registration.
postconditions: Malformed values are rejected and the malformed field is reported; well-formed values are accepted for KYC submission.
assumptions: Verification is format-check only; no real Aadhaar/PAN verification against external systems is performed in v1.

title: Route KYC application to Bank operations review
statement: The system shall route a submitted KYC application to Bank operations for review.
preconditions: A KYC application has passed format validation and is in a submitted state.
postconditions: The KYC application is visible to Bank operations in a pending-review state.
assumptions: Routing to Bank operations is performed automatically on submission.

title: Approve or reject a KYC application
statement: Bank operations shall be able to approve or reject a KYC submission.
preconditions: The KYC application is in the pending-review state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.
postconditions: The KYC application reaches an approved or rejected state; approval enables account creation in step FR-005.
assumptions: A rejected application is not automatically resubmittable in v1.

title: Create pending account on KYC approval
statement: The system shall create an account record upon KYC approval, in a pending (not yet active) state.
preconditions: A KYC application associated with the customer has been approved.
postconditions: An account record is created in the pending state, not yet usable for transactions.
assumptions: An account cannot be opened before KYC is approved.

title: Activate a pending account
statement: Bank operations shall be able to activate a pending account.
preconditions: The account is in the pending state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.
postconditions: The account transitions to the active state and becomes usable for transactions.
assumptions: Activation is performed only by Bank operations.

title: Freeze an active account
statement: Bank operations shall be able to freeze an active account.
preconditions: The account is in the active state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.
postconditions: The account transitions to the frozen state; it no longer permits outgoing transfers.
assumptions: Freezing is performed by Bank operations; thawing is out of the stated v1 scope.

title: Login with valid credentials
statement: The system shall allow Customer and Bank operations users to log in with valid credentials.
preconditions: The user holds a valid identity and credentials for the Customer or Bank operations role.
postconditions: An authenticated session is established for the user.
assumptions: Login applies uniformly to both roles in v1.

title: Reject login with invalid credentials
statement: The system shall reject login attempts with invalid credentials.
preconditions: A user submits a login attempt with invalid credentials.
postconditions: The login attempt is rejected and no session is established.
assumptions: Invalid-credential attempts present a generic failure message to mitigate credential probing.

title: Logout and terminate session
statement: The system shall allow an authenticated user to log out, terminating the session.
preconditions: The user holds an authenticated session.
postconditions: The session is terminated and protected functionality is no longer accessible.
assumptions: Logout applies uniformly to both roles in v1.

title: Customer initiates a transfer
statement: The system shall allow an authenticated Customer to initiate a money transfer from their own account to another account.
preconditions: The Customer is authenticated, holds an active account, and specifies a transfer amount and a recipient account.
postconditions: A transfer is processed that debits the sender balance and credits the recipient balance, and a transaction is recorded.
assumptions: All money movement is synthetic; no real funds move in v1.

title: Prevent Bank operations from initiating transfers
statement: The system shall prevent Bank operations users from initiating money transfers.
preconditions: A Bank operations user attempts to initiate a money transfer.
postconditions: The attempt is denied and no transfer is created.
assumptions: Bank operations role has no transfer capability in v1.

title: Debit sender and credit recipient on success
statement: The system shall debit the sender's synthetic balance and credit the recipient's synthetic balance upon a successful transfer.
preconditions: A transfer initiated by a Customer passes all validation checks.
postconditions: The sender's balance is reduced by the transfer amount and the recipient's balance is increased by the same amount.
assumptions: All balances are synthetic.

title: Record a transaction for every transfer
statement: The system shall record a transaction entry for every transfer, visible to both the sending and receiving Customer.
preconditions: A transfer has been successfully processed.
postconditions: A transaction entry exists and is visible to both the sending and receiving Customer.
assumptions: Each transfer yields exactly one transaction entry referencing both parties.

title: View an account statement
statement: The system shall allow Customer and Bank operations users to view an account statement for a selected account and period.
preconditions: The user is authenticated and selects an account and a period they are permitted to view.
postconditions: A statement for the selected account and period is displayed.
assumptions: Both roles may view a statement in v1.

title: Download an account statement as a file
statement: The system shall allow a Customer to download their account statement as a file.
preconditions: The Customer is authenticated and selects their own account and a statement period.
postconditions: A downloadable statement file is produced for the Customer.
assumptions: Only the Customer role may download a statement in v1.

title: Audit-trail view of account and transaction state changes
statement: The system shall provide Bank operations with an audit-trail view of account and transaction state changes.
preconditions: The actor holds the Bank operations role and is authenticated.
postconditions: Bank operations can view the recorded state changes for accounts and transactions.
assumptions: The audit trail is derived from logged state-changing events per FR-021 (NF4).

title: Baseline security controls
statement: KYC and account data shall be protected with baseline security controls (e.g., encryption in transit, access control by role).
preconditions: KYC or account data exists in the system.
postconditions: The data remains protected through encryption in transit and role-based access control.
assumptions: Baseline controls cover encryption in transit and role-based access for v1.

title: Mask Customer PII outside KYC review
statement: Customer PII (Aadhaar, PAN) shall be masked in UI displays and logs outside of authorized KYC review contexts.
preconditions: Aadhaar or PAN data is rendered in a UI display or written to a log.
postconditions: PII is masked everywhere except authorized KYC review contexts.
assumptions: Authorized KYC review contexts expose full values; all other displays and logs mask them.

title: Baseline accessibility conformance
statement: Customer-facing screens shall meet baseline accessibility conformance (e.g., keyboard-navigable, labeled form fields).
preconditions: A customer-facing screen is rendered.
postconditions: The screen is keyboard-navigable and its form fields are labeled.
assumptions: Baseline conformance covers keyboard navigation and labeled fields for v1.

title: Log every state-changing action
statement: Every state-changing action (KYC decision, account activation/freeze, transfer) shall be logged with actor, timestamp, and before/after state to support the audit trail.
preconditions: A state-changing action on a KYC application, account, or transaction is performed.
postconditions: The action is logged with actor, timestamp, and before/after state.
assumptions: The log entry is immutable once written.

title: Schema-valid, source-linked artifacts
statement: Agent-generated pipeline artifacts (BRD, business rules, requirements) shall be schema-valid and source-linked to enable automated traceability checks.
preconditions: An agent-generated artifact is produced at any pipeline stage.
postconditions: The artifact is schema-valid and carries explicit source links.
assumptions: Artifacts undergo automated schema validation and traceability checks.

title: Reliable and testable end-to-end journeys
statement: Each in-scope customer journey (onboarding, login, transfer, statement) shall be reliable and testable such that it can be exercised end-to-end via automation.
preconditions: An in-scope customer journey is available in the system.
postconditions: The journey can be exercised end-to-end by automated tests.
assumptions: Stable test hooks (e.g., data-testid) are provided; exact convention is pending OQ-004.
